newsitem.title: UK: Med oil products unchanged to firmer in quiet trad.
newsitem.headline: Med oil products unchanged to firmer in quiet trad.

text.p: Mediterranean oil products were slightly firmer on Monday, traders said.
Gas oil rose marginally on the back of firmer IPE futures and premiums were steady.
A cargo of Russian was offered at Nov IPE +$2 and bid at +$1 but trade was very thin. Traders said the heating oil market was in balance and noted weak demand for low sulphur diesel.

Gasoline prices were slightly higher in a quiet start to the week but traders said the market looked firm due to strong crude prices and a cut in gasoline production as refiners maximize distillate output.
One trader said there was demand for Lebanese grade gasoline but no sellers were cited.
Naphtha prices were unchanged from Friday with the reopening of Algeria's Skikda port late last week alleviating some buying pressure.

Fuel oil activity was slow with prices steady to a touch firmer on the back of crude rise on Friday and consolidation today. The high sulhpur cracked market continues to show a keen interest in Romanian demand for up to 1.2 million tonnes this winter but the difficulties of finance continue.

"I don't think anybody needs persuading they (the Romanians) want the product, but concern of paying for the fuel is still around," said one trader. High sulphur cracked prices remained under $120 fob Med.
Low sulphur cracked buying was lacklustre, with nothing seen done and prices continued to hover around the mid $130s cif Italy.
